inboxDescription: Every client request in one inbox: triage, assign and keep them within their SLA.
portalDescription: Submit new work to the agency and follow each request to completion.
newRequestDescription: Tell us what you need — the more detail, the faster we can start.
chooseForm: Choose the kind of request so we ask the right questions.
noFormsTitle: No request types are available yet
noFormsBody: Your agency hasn't published any request forms. You can still message your account manager.
searchPlaceholder: Search by title, number or client
internalNoteHint: Turn on “Internal note” in the composer to write something the client won't see.
messageToClientHint: Posted in the request conversation and included in the notification.
waitingPlaceholder: What do you need from the client?
cancelBody: The agency will stop working on it. You can submit a new request at any time.
submitted: Request {number} submitted. We'll be in touch soon.
attachHint: Drag files here or choose up to {max} (images, PDFs, videos, documents).
responseTime: We usually reply within {hours, plural, one {# working hour} other {# working hours}}.
waitingBody: The team is waiting for your reply to continue. Answer in the conversation below.

fields.title: Title
fields.titleHint: A short summary, e.g. “National Day post for Instagram”.
fields.urgentHint: Flags the request as high priority.

actionHints.submitted: The request goes back to the queue.
actionHints.in_review: Let the client know you're looking at the request.
actionHints.in_progress: The team is working on it; the client sees “In progress”.
actionHints.waiting_client: Work pauses until the client replies. Say exactly what you need.
actionHints.completed: The client is notified that the request is done.
actionHints.declined: Explain why so the client knows what to do next.
actionHints.cancelled: The request is closed without being done.

tracker.declined: This request was declined. See the conversation for details.

open.title: Inbox zero
open.body: No open requests right now. New ones will appear here.

mine.title: Nothing assigned to you
mine.body: Requests assigned to you will show up here.

unassigned.title: Everything is assigned
unassigned.body: Every open request has an owner.

closed.title: No closed requests yet
closed.body: Completed, declined and cancelled requests are kept here.

all.title: No requests yet
all.body: Requests submitted from the client portal will appear here.

portalEmpty.activeBody: Need a design, a video or a campaign? Submit a request and track it here.
portalEmpty.activeBodyReadOnly: Requests submitted by your team will appear here.
portalEmpty.closedBody: Completed and cancelled requests will be kept here.

forms.title: Request forms
forms.description: The request types your clients can submit, with the questions each one asks.
forms.created: Form created. Add its questions, then publish.
forms.summary: {fields, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}} · {requests, plural, one {# request} other {# requests}}
forms.emptyBody: Create a form for each kind of work your clients ask for — posts, videos, campaigns.
forms.archivedToast: Form archived. Clients can no longer choose it.

builder.description: Edit the questions, preview them as the client will see them, then publish a new version.
builder.noFieldsBody: Add the questions you need answered before work can start.
builder.titleNote: Every request also asks for a title, a needed-by date, urgency and attachments.
builder.draftPending: A draft is waiting to be published.
builder.publishBody: New requests will use these questions. Requests already submitted keep the version they were answered with.
builder.published: Published. Clients now see the new version.
builder.discardBody: Your unpublished changes will be lost; the published version stays as it is.
